node.title: Re: Problem with XSLoader in Dumper.pm while using coverage
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: [mod://Devel::Cover] only contains a Devel/Cover/Dumper.pm file, but that shouldn't conflict with Data/Dumper.pm unless you've done something strange with the paths. Maybe you could explain the directory layout a little more? And are you sure you've pointed PERL5LIB to the lib path (the directory that contains the directory Devel) and not somewhere else? Or was perhaps PERL5LIB pointing to somewhere else before you changed it?
